name: Chronicle 2.0
tagline: AI-assisted presentations that actually look and feel human-crafted.
problem: Generic AI presentation tools produce cookie-cutter, low-quality slides that undermine professional credibility. Chronicle 2.0 addresses the gap between AI speed and design quality, giving users polished, thoughtful presentations without the telltale signs of AI-generated slop.
useCases: Creating client-facing pitch decks that maintain brand standards
Building internal strategy presentations quickly without design resources
Producing sales enablement materials at scale
Turning research or reports into visually compelling slide narratives
